name: Chain
description: Oval links running edge to edge, each one overlapping its neighbours.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -20%; top: 22%; width: 140%; height: 56%; border-radius: 999px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 72%, #000 72%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 72%, #000 72%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
